identity.name: Palghat Mani Iyer
identity.summary: Carnatic mridangam player, one of the "Holy Trinity of Mridangam" with Palani Subramaniam Pillai and Ramanathapuram Murugabhoopathy; accompanied the leading singers of his era from Chembai Vaidyanatha Bhagavathar (1924) on, and was the first mridangist to receive the Sangeetha Kalanidhi (1966).

contribution.description: Changed the mridangam from "just keeping beat for the main artist’s music" to "an instrument in its own right", accompanying the singer’s phrasing instead of only keeping time.
